params.1273: Given by Vannaka in Edgeville Dungeon for completing all Hard Tasks in Varrock.
params.1292: Varrock armour 3 and a magic lamp worth 10,000xp in a skill of your choice.
params.1274: The armour gains the following extra benefits:
params.1275: - Chance of smelting two bars at once up to adamant at Edgeville's furnace.
params.1276: - Chance of mining two ores at once up to adamantite.
params.1277: - Chance of smithing items at a faster rate.
params.1278: - Access the Cooking Guild without a chef's hat, and access its bank.
params.1279: Naff will sell up to 64 battlestaves a day.
